research_question: What does the 2025 SCF show about retirement account balances by age, and how should means and medians be read?

research_brief.purpose: Present SCF 2025 retirement data by age with populations stated.
research_brief.audience: US savers comparing themselves with benchmarks.
research_brief.data_period: SCF 2016-2025 surveys (released Oct 9, 2026), 2025 dollars; Vanguard 2025 plan data; IRS 2026 limits.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Age table is means among account holders only; families not individuals.

statistics.claim: Retirement accounts held by 54.3% (2022) and 54.9% (2025); conditional median 95.2K to 106.0K (+11%); mean 365.7K to 451.1K (+23%)
Plan participation 65.1% in 2025 vs 64.4% 2022 (ref person 64 or younger); ~70% ages 45-64, 66% ages 35-44; youngest DC/IRA 42% (2016) to near 50%; DB about one-fourth
73% of eligible employees participated; 11% of pay combined; 21,000+ small businesses
